title: View state
description: A chart's interactive state (REQ-VIEW-010): what is in view, the cursor, the selection, hidden series, the page's time cursor and a view animation in flight. A frame is a function of data, options, this view and `t` only. Every domain is in data units (a timestamp in epoch ms), and null means the chart's fitted default (REQ-VIEW-020). Read from the element's `view` property or `Chart.view()`, it is whole. Set as the `view` property or attribute, it may be partial: every property is optional, a partial view is merged into the current one key by key, and a key set to null returns to its default (REQ-VIEW-030). Indices in `cursor` and `selection.points` are positions in the data as held now; after a replace or a trimming append they are re-derived from x, so a page linking or saving a view should rely on x values.

version.description: The view state's shape version, so it can grow.

x.description: The x axis's view. null returns it to the fitted default.

domain.description: The visible x range [low, high]; null fits the data.

follow.description: Live mode: the domain keeps its span and ends at the newest datum as appends arrive. A pan away from the end sets it false; End sets it true (REQ-VIEW-060).

y.description: The first y scale's view. null returns it to the fitted default.

axes.description: Further y scales (a volume pane, a right axis), keyed by the scale names the options give. null returns them all to their defaults.

cursor.description: The crosshair, or null for none.

x.description: The cursor's x in data units.

y.description: The cursor's y in data units, the snapped datum's y.

series.description: The series the cursor snapped to, by name.

index.description: The row of the datum the cursor snapped to.

locked.description: Keeps the cursor when the pointer leaves: a click or Enter locks it, Escape unlocks it.

selection.description: What the reader brushed and selected, or null for nothing.

x.description: A brushed x range [low, high], or null.

y.description: A brushed y range [low, high], or null.

hidden.description: Series toggled off, by name. null shows every series.

time.description: The page's time cursor in x units: a vertical marker and a readout, independent of the pointer. null for none.

motion.description: A view animation in flight (an eased zoom, a kinetic pan, a reset) for the x domain, stamped with play time, so the frame at any `t` is determined without replaying input (REQ-VIEW-050). At t ≥ t0 + duration it folds into `x.domain`. null for none; with reduced motion and no `motion` attribute there is none.

kind.description: ease: an eased move from `from` to `to`; kinetic: a pan decelerating from its release velocity.

t0.description: Play time in seconds at which the motion starts.

to.description: The x domain at t0 + duration.

span.description: A range [low, high] in data units, low ≤ high.

range.description: A range [low, high] in data units, or null for the default.

axis.description: A y scale's view, or null for its fitted default.

domain.description: The visible range [low, high]; null with `fit`.

fit.description: visible (default): fit to the data in the x domain; all: fit to all data; fixed: keep `domain`.

point.description: A datum by series and row.

index.description: The datum's row in the data as held now.
